title: Super Veggie Nachos
subtitle: with Sweet Potato, Charred Corn and Avo
description: It’s plant power all the way with our super-tasty vegan dishes! Our meat-free, dairy-free, honey-free dishes are amped with plant-based proteins, fresh produce, nuts and seeds. Best of all, they’re for everyone, whether you’re vegan, vegetarian or flexitarian.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Check your avocado is ripe before starting this recipe (see Kitchen notes). Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Discard the husk and silks from the corn, then slice the kernels from the cob. Pick the coriander leaves and finely chop the stems. Peel the sweet potato, then coarsely grate. Drain and rinse the beans.

Soften sweet potato: Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium deep frypan over high heat. Cook the sweet potato, beans and coriander stems, stirring, for 3-4 mins until the sweet potato is softened. Add half the tomato paste, 2 tsp Mexican seasoning (see Kitchen notes) and 2 tsp soy sauce and cook, stirring, for 30 secs or until fragrant.

Simmer sweet potato: Add 180ml (¾ cup) water to the sweet potato mixture and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, for 6-8 mins until thickened. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Bake tortilla chips: Meanwhile, combine ½ tsp Mexican seasoning and 2 tsp olive oil in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Brush the tortillas with the spiced oil, then cut into wedges. Put on the lined tray and bake, turning halfway, for 8-10 mins until crisp and golden.

Serve up: While the tortillas are baking, heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the corn, stirring, for 5-6 mins until charred. Remove the pan from the heat. Cut the avocado into 1cm chunks. Divide the sweet potato mixture among bowls. Scatter over the corn, avocado and coriander leaves. Serve with the tortilla chips and enjoy!

Kitchen notes: To speed up the ripening process, put the avocado in a paper bag and loosely close, then leave on the kitchen bench for a day or two. Add a banana to the bag to make the avocado ripen faster. ~ Our Mexican seasoning has a mild chilli kick, so reduce the amount if you want to avoid the heat.
